senses.zh_definition: 英语人名 Lauren，通常用作女性名字，常音译为“劳伦”；属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: A personal given name, used predominantly for women.
senses.ms_definition: Nama diri bahasa Inggeris yang lazim digunakan sebagai nama perempuan; tergolong dalam kata nama khas.
senses.nuances: 输入的小写形式通常应规范为 Lauren。不能从这个名字单独确定某位人物、性别、国籍或宗教。此处马来语释义为说明性编写，非 DBP 官方释义；没有依据标记为 official。参见 [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/lauren)。以下搭配是姓名使用框架，并非有频率证据的固定搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Lauren belongs to the name family of Laurence, ultimately associated with the Latin name Laurentius and the place Laurentum. Its widespread feminine use was helped by actress Lauren Bacall’s stage name. This is a history of personal naming, rather than Malay word formation, and it does not give every present-day bearer a literal descriptive meaning. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lauren)
